claims: Arizona defeated Purdue 79-64 in the West Regional Final of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament.
Purdue is the (2) seed in the West Regional of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament.
Arizona is the (1) seed in the West Regional of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament.
Illinois defeated Iowa 71-59 in the South Regional Final of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament.
Iowa is the (9) seed in the South Regional of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament.
Illinois is the (3) seed in the South Regional of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament.
Duke vs. UConn is the East Regional Final of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament on Sunday, March 29.
Duke is the (1) seed in the East Regional of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament.
UConn is the (2) seed in the East Regional of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament.
Michigan vs. Tennessee is the Midwest Regional Final of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament on Sunday, March 29.
Michigan is the (1) seed in the Midwest Regional of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament.
Tennessee is the (6) seed in the Midwest Regional of the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament.
Arizona reached their first Final Four since 2001.
Arizona's freshmen had a 52-point performance against Purdue.
Illinois advanced to their second Elite Eight in three years.
The Big Ten conference held half of the Elite Eight spots.
The 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament Final Four is at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, IN.
The 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament Final Four dates include Saturday, April 4, 2026.
